farmasi-boss-trip.title: FARMASI · Boss Trip event collection
farmasi-boss-trip.description: Personalised sailboat table pieces, decorative rings and branded presentation packaging. A nautical theme connects the individual names, graphics and packaging across the collection.
details: More than a single object: coordinated table pieces, decorative objects and a boxed presentation.

For a similar brief, we review quantities, the personalisation list, brand artwork, packaging and delivery destination together. Manufacturing methods, dimensions and finishes are agreed for each project.

gallery.alt: Wood-effect sailboat table pieces with individual names and FARMASI Boss Trip graphics
gallery.caption: Sailboat table pieces · Individual names and coordinated brand graphics.

gallery.alt: White decorative rings with black straps, stitching and rope details
gallery.caption: Decorative rings · Black-and-white surfaces, stitching and rope details.

farmasi-boss-trip.note: The images present the project collection. The ring-shaped objects are decorative and are not offered as lifesaving equipment.

modular-artificial-rock-concert-environm.title: Modular rock concert environment
modular-artificial-rock-concert-environm.description: An artificial-rock environment made as transportable EPS modules and assembled into a continuous landscape around the concert stage. The project follows workshop production through to the completed arena setting.

cosmetic-bottle-display-props.title: Cosmetic bottle display props
cosmetic-bottle-display-props.description: Oversized packaging forms create a focal point for a branded setting. Bottle profiles, shaped caps, coloured surfaces and applied graphics make the products recognisable.

giant-burger-display-prop.title: Giant burger display prop
giant-burger-display-prop.description: A sculptural food display with individually shaped ingredient layers, textured surfaces and paint. The workshop photograph shows the assembled composition and surface treatment.

classical-decorative-columns.title: Classical decorative columns
classical-decorative-columns.description: A pair of decorative columns with fluted shafts, scroll capitals and bases. Repeated architectural details are unified by a coordinated stone-effect finish.

ornamental-elephant-sculpture.title: Ornamental elephant sculpture
ornamental-elephant-sculpture.description: An elephant-head sculpture with prominent curved tusks and ornamental relief. The white surface highlights the patterned detail and layered sculptural form.

decorative-entrance-arch.title: Decorative entrance arch
decorative-entrance-arch.description: A shaped ornamental surround defines the storefront entrance. The installation photograph shows the light-coloured arch being positioned against the darker facade.

retail-brand-activations.title: Retail & brand activations
retail-brand-activations.description: Oversized product replicas, bespoke displays, counters and brand elements. Visual identity, display duration, visitor contact and shipping dimensions are considered together.

events-exhibitions.title: Events & exhibitions
events-exhibitions.description: Scenic forms, exhibition displays and photo settings. Production is planned around modularity, access, installation windows and reuse.

museums-themed-attractions.title: Museums & themed attractions
museums-themed-attractions.description: Sculptures, animal figures, reliefs and landscape elements. Close-view detail, maintenance, fixings and visitor access are assessed within the project.

hospitality-architectural-decor.title: Hospitality & architectural decor
hospitality-architectural-decor.description: Fitted and freestanding furniture, reception counters, columns and facade details. Dimensions, material interfaces, finish and installation connections are planned together.

film-television.title: Film & television
film-television.description: Studio scenery, oversized camera-facing props and custom forms. Viewing angles, lighting, handling, portability and assembly sequence guide the work.

prototypes-display-models.title: Prototypes & display models
prototypes-display-models.description: Models for form review, presentation or subsequent manufacturing. CNC, printing or molding is selected for the purpose, tolerances, finish and number of copies.

SC-001.title: Olive lounge concept
SC-001.description: A design direction combining olive seating, walnut tones, bronze details, smoked glass and warm lighting.

SC-002.title: Futuristic pod concept
SC-002.description: A reception or display concept built around a sculptural pod, metallic outer surface, warm timber interior details and concealed lighting.

SC-003.title: Custom thematic interior elements
SC-003.description: Sculptural seating, mirrors, reliefs and branded objects can be developed around the space and its atmosphere.
